title: RPFood
body:
# RPFood is a Minecraft mod that adds a variety of new food items that can be crafted and used in survival.
**The goal of the mod is to provide more options for building restaurants, cafés, kitchens, and other roleplay-oriented builds while keeping everything balanced and compatible with normal gameplay.**

Currently included categories:

• Drinks

• Burgers

• BBQ items

• Bakery items

• Additional general food types


**All items use recipes that fit naturally into survival progression. RPFood is suitable for roleplay servers, building projects, or players who want more culinary variety in their worlds.**
